test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 27 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Two sprinters cover the same distance at the speed of 18 km/h and 20 km/h, respectively. Find the distance traveled when one takes 15 minutes longer than the other.
solution:
Given:

Speed: A = 18 km/h, B = 20 km/h

Formula Used:

Distance = Speed × Time

Calculation:

Let, the distance be x km

According to the question,

x/18 – x/20 = 15/60

⇒ (20x – 18x)/360 = 15/60

⇒ x = 9× 5

⇒ x = 45

**∴ The distance = 45km**
